title: ai-tally onboarding instrumentation recipe
description: CTO-261 section 5.2. One machine-readable recipe per framework / provider. The recipe catalog is the reliability mechanism: the onboarding agent retrieves and adapts a known-good recipe rather than hand-writing the SDK API. Every recipe with an sdk_surface.call is additionally checked by tests/test_recipes.py, which resolves the emitted call against the real SDK surface.

detect.description: How the agent knows this recipe applies (section 3 step 1).

imports.description: Import names or dependency-manifest tokens that signal this component.

call_patterns.description: Call-site substrings that mark a candidate edit point.

web_framework.description: For middleware recipes: the web framework this middleware targets.

sdk_surface.description: Pins the recipe to a real SDK symbol. Recipes emit the module-level convenience form; delegates_to records the instance method it wraps (section 5.2, 5.3).

call.description: The module-level convenience form the edit.template emits, e.g. tally.record_vector_call. Null only for the otel-ingest recipe, which emits config, not an SDK call.

delegates_to.description: Fully-qualified instance method the module-level convenience wraps, e.g. tally.client.TallyClient.record_vector_call.

required_args.description: Arguments the emitted call must carry. Validated to be real parameters of delegates_to.

layer.description: Gateway cost-layer / coverage bucket this recipe lands in.

template.description: The adaptable code template. Named holes are {snake_case} and are filled from the concrete call site by the agent.

verify.description: Names the coverage layer that must light up (section 7).

operation_name.description: Value of the GenAiOperation column the gateway buckets on (tool, vector, embeddings, chat).
